decisions.reason: Despite no longer being observed on the website, this illuminated candle arch still fits the firm's traditional premium seasonal craft range closely enough that management would be inclined to retain it unless demand has clearly faded.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's core assortment, so even without recent prominence it remains a natural product to keep in a long-established handcrafted seasonal range.

The electronic music box was a more distant, technology-leaning departure from the firm's traditional handcrafted identity, and its disappearance from view suggests the firm would now reallocate effort back toward core wooden folk-art products.
As a less prominent accessory tied to the weaker-fitting electronic music-box concept, this motif platform is highly likely to be removed when the firm rationalizes its assortment.
Although its Christmas theme matches the firm's seasonal business, it still depends on the less established electronic music-box platform and is therefore likely to be discontinued.
This themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's established strengths in handcrafted wooden seasonal décor, making it more likely to stay than to be withdrawn.
